name: Soviet Union (1922–1923)
description: A red field with the state emblem of the Soviet Union, a hammer and sickle over a globe within wheat ears bound with red ribbons and topped by a star, in the centre.
history: The first flag of the Soviet Union, adopted at the First Congress of Soviets on 30 December 1922 and described in the constitution accepted on 6 July 1923: the state emblem on a red banner. It was the official flag for only a few months, replaced on 12 November 1923 by the familiar hammer-and-sickle design.
